A foundry log for restoration capital — line by line, hectare by hectare.

Sable Anchor Foundry routes donor capital into long-cycle ecological restoration: peatlands, riverine corridors, and degraded coastal woodland. Every pound is tagged to a project, a milestone, and a measurable unit of land returned to function.

§ 02 · MISSION & METHOD
Ratified 2019-03-11

We finance the slow work of putting landscapes back to function. Not gardens, not gestures — contiguous, measurable, indefinitely owned acreage placed under restoration covenant and monitored against pre-agreed ecological baselines.

The Foundry was incorporated in 2019 as a Scottish Charitable Incorporated Organisation (SC049217) after the closure of the Anchor Bay Estate trust. We operate as a single-stage grantmaker: capital arrives, is held in segregated project accounts, and is disbursed against milestone evidence verified by an independent ecologist on rotation. Donors see every disbursement on the dashboard within 72 hours of authorisation.

We do not run our own field crews. We commission them — from regional trusts, community land partnerships, and a small number of contracted ecologists — and we publish the contracts. The Foundry's discipline is in the accounting and the patience; the work itself belongs to those who live where the work happens.

§ 04 · OPERATING PRINCIPLES
Six tenets · non-negotiable
01
Land first, narrative second.

We commit to acreage with measurable baseline degradation. We do not commission projects to generate stories; the stories follow the soil.

02
Disbursement against evidence.

No tranche is released without milestone sign-off from a rotating independent ecologist. The rotation list is published quarterly.

03
Local hands, local payrolls.

A minimum of 60% of project labour cost must accrue to residents within a 40-km radius of the work site. Verified by HMRC payroll extract.

04
Permanence by covenant.

All Foundry-funded land is placed under a restoration covenant of no fewer than 99 years, registered with the relevant land authority before tranche 2.

05
No greenwashing instruments.

The Foundry does not sell, broker, or originate carbon credits, biodiversity units, or offset products. Restoration is the product; nothing is monetised downstream.

06
Public ledger or it didn't happen.

Every disbursement, contract, and milestone report is published within 72 hours. Donor names may be anonymised; sums and recipients cannot.
